reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_version` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_version`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The Envoy policy-map version metric is reported as `envoy_cilium_npds_version` instead of `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_version`, so queries that use the old name need to be updated.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and recording rules that use `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_version` to use `envoy_cilium_npds_version`.

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_version` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_version`, so monitoring that uses the old name needs to be checked.
